remaining_limit: The rc.7 edit implementation throws plain Error for blank file_path, empty old_string and equal old/new strings, so those three cases honestly share edit_error_untyped_argument_constraint unless a future runner validates them before dispatch.

rerun_effect: A future edit failure can be narrowed locally from stable result metadata and exact state hashes; another paid request is not needed merely to rediscover whether the edit boundary, filesystem match or mutation succeeded.
next_recommendation: Integrate the seven-coordinate classifier and pre-dispatch semantic argument checks into a provider-free future-runner rehearsal before deciding whether any new occupied worker attempt is justified.
